hypothesis: Global cross-group signed spike evidence with source coupling context can reject a transitive positive bridge while retaining spatially connected instances.

source.source_lineage: same-seed SW0097 strict native16-to32 source mapping
source.graph_parameters: untouched source learned parameters; fixed power2/effective contrast8 T operator

inputs.Q: exact production positive-clamped component-Pearson-product from actual emitted component spikes,settle512
inputs.A: unmodified actual GraphVectorKuramoto.prepare_coupling return tuple[0], including native symmetrization/ReLU/1e-6 floor
inputs.capture: process-local instance wrapper calls original prepare once and returns identical tuple; restore callable finally; one prepare call per static image
inputs.gain: actual exp(graph.log_coupling_gain), not geodesic contrast or Kuramoto K
inputs.solver_dtype: CPU float64 copies; preserve/hash original float32 Q/A bytes

partition.eligible: at least one original horizontal/vertical grid edge between groups; no wrap/diagonal
partition.merge_gain: sum signed_energy over ALL cross-group patch pairs
partition.tie: exact equal gain: lexicographically smallest sorted pair of group first-patch indices
partition.updates: union group adjacency; summed dense group gains retained also for currently nonadjacent groups

mask_readout.background: largest size>=8 group; first row-major patch breaks size ties
mask_readout.positive_labels: remaining groups ordered by first patch index

required: actual A finite symmetric positive 1024 matrix

evaluation.reference: validated SW0143-T seed1 archived exact labels and source lineage
evaluation.control_replay: all320 control labels exactly equal archived sourceT before GT access
evaluation.ground_truth_order: freeze and validate candidate/control/Slot predictions and protocols first; GT masks last
evaluation.failure: close fixed recipe; no threshold/weight/K/neighbor sweep or automatic training
evaluation.conditional_replication: only after passing seed1 gate, consider same fixed source0/2 recipe
evaluation.final_goal: all3 mean metrics strictly above comparable own70kSlot; FG mean>=.87 separately assessed

claim_limits: no automatic new training objective or 70k queue
